item.tprt.anchor_sword.description: A heavy, exotic weapon that enhances both melee combat and defense
item.tprt.magic_blade.description: A weapon whose attacks deal additional magic damage (requires the [Enchanting] modifier)
item.tprt.lance.description: A weapon built for high mobility: hold right click to charge into enemies
material.tprt.chtholly.flavor: Even as the sun sets and no future is in sight, please never forget the brilliance of this very moment.
material.tprt.chtholly.encyclopedia: A crystal of the world's end, woven from azure starfire and the lingering warmth of sunset. Can be cast into a full range of Tinkers' Construct weapon, ranged weapon, armor, curio, and spellbook parts.
material.tprt.mixeddragon.flavor: A legendary substance, rarely seen in form
material.tprt.blazeforged_steel.flavor: Blazing blood quenched into hammered steel
material.tprt.advanced_manyullyn.flavor: This is the legendary Manyullyn that can sever galaxies!
material.tprt.source_alloy.flavor: The perfect fusion of magic and metal
material.tprt.cursium.flavor: A legendary warrior of the past, now a cursed undead
material.tprt.witherite.flavor: A technological marvel from ancient times
material.tprt.evil_beast_alloy.flavor: The silent guardians of the Soul Forge
material.tprt.black_steel.flavor: A unique alloy forged by the ancient craftsmen of the snowy plains
material.tprt.ancient_metal.flavor: An ancient, resilient metal originating from the desert
material.tprt.koboleton_bone.flavor: Bones of an ancient remnant, far stronger than ordinary bone
material.tprt.amethyst_crab_shell.flavor: The chitinous shell of an Amethyst Crab, brimming with the power of the earth (said to undergo a wondrous change when blessed by amethyst)
material.tprt.tears_of_the_storm.flavor: Crystallized tears of a goddess, imbued with the might of storms
material.tprt.lacrima.flavor: A crystallization of the ocean; for some reason it fills you with a faint sorrow.
material.tprt.abyss_fragment.flavor: Fragments left by the Leviathan, chilling to the bone
material.tprt.void_power_alloy.flavor: A component of the Ender Guardian, capable of harnessing the power of the void
material.tprt.sandstorm_skeleton.flavor: The remains of a bone dragon that slumbered for millions of years, with the power to command sandstorms
material.tprt.void_jaw.flavor: The mandibles of an Endermaptera, suitable for crafting arrows
material.tprt.stymphalian_bird_feather.f: Arrows fitted with these feathers soar like birds of prey
material.tprt.dragonbone.flavor: “Seriously, doesn't forging bones into tools and weapons like metal sound ridiculous to you?” — Blacksmith's Apprentice
material.tprt.composite_dragon_scales.fl: Imbued with the power of dragons
material.tprt.hydra_fang.flavor: The fangs of a Hydra, steeped in deadly venom
material.tprt.sea_serpent_fang.flavor: The fangs of a Sea Serpent, with the power to cleave the tides
material.tprt.sea_serpent_scales.flavor: The scales of a Sea Serpent, brimming with the power of the ocean
material.tprt.frosted_helve.flavor: Suffused with bitter cold and the mysteries of frost
material.tprt.hogskin.flavor: The hide of a Nether beast, tough yet able to channel mana with ease
material.tprt.arcane_metal.flavor: Specially processed metal, brimming with mana
material.tprt.dragonskin.flavor: Scales of the Ender Dragon, brimming with the power of the End
material.tprt.bloody_vellum.flavor: Some presence is answering your call...
material.tprt.pyrium.flavor: A hidden treasure of the Nether
modifier.tprt.the_dragon_power.flavor: Obtain the power of the Dragon God
modifier.tprt.the_dragon_power.descripti: Increases damage dealt by 20% per 10 maximum health. Above 200 maximum health, further damage bonuses become a separate multiplier.
modifier.tprt.the_dragon_lord.descriptio: Grants flight at 100 or more maximum health, and additional damage reduction based on maximum health.
modifier.tprt.mixeddragon_ranged.flavor: The power of dragons surges unceasingly
modifier.tprt.mixeddragon_ranged.descrip: Greatly increases projectile power and projectile speed
modifier.tprt.be_thoroughly_tempered.fla: The power of forging lies within
modifier.tprt.be_thoroughly_tempered.des: Increases all attributes of the tool
modifier.tprt.be_thoroughly_tempered_cur: The power of forging lies within
Per level: Increases max health by 6% and attack damage by 6%
modifier.tprt.self_ignition.description: Hitting a target sets you on fire for 5 seconds. While burning, deal fire damage equal to your attack damage every second to creatures within 4 blocks.
modifier.tprt.flame_bathed.description: Converts 50% of non-fire damage taken into fire damage. Fire damage taken is reduced by 50%.
death.attack.tprt.converted_fire: %1$s was reduced to ashes by converted flames
death.attack.tprt.converted_fire.player: %1$s was reduced to ashes by converted flames while fighting %2$s
modifier.tprt.quenching.description: Taking fire damage grants 1 Scorch stack, up to 10. Each stack reduces damage by 1.5% per equipped level, up to 4 levels total. All stacks expire after 10 seconds without fire damage.
modifier.tprt.flame_ignition.flavor: Arrows kindle flames that consume friend and foe
modifier.tprt.flame_ignition.description: Firing ignites you for 5 seconds. Arrows fired while burning ignite their target and deal fire damage equal to the arrow hit once per second for 5 seconds to the target and nearby enemies within 4 blocks.
modifier.tprt.ranged_kindled_rebirth.fla: Embers never die in the ashes
modifier.tprt.ranged_kindled_rebirth.des: Taking fire damage grants 1 Scorch point, up to 20. Each point adds 5% arrow and Kindling Shot damage. All points expire after 10 seconds without fire damage.
modifier.tprt.kindled_rebirth.flavor: Embers never die in the ashes
modifier.tprt.kindled_rebirth.descriptio: Taking fire damage grants 1 Scorch stack, up to 20. Each stack adds 5% melee damage and Self-Combustion fire damage. All stacks expire after 10 seconds without fire damage.
modifier.tprt.furnace_core.flavor: Your body the furnace, molten fire the heart
modifier.tprt.furnace_core.description: While burning, deal 20% more damage, gain 20% attack and arrow speed and 15% movement speed, and restore 2% of missing health every second.
modifier.tprt.source_charge.flavor: Every incantation charges the metal with power
modifier.tprt.source_charge.description: Melee hits build Source Charge (up to 5 stacks; duration refreshed to 30 seconds). At full stacks, the next melee hit detonates, dealing magic damage equal to this hit's damage × stacks × 40% × √spell power. Also grants temporary health equal to 20% of maximum health (40% below half health) for 30 seconds and increases the next spell's level by 50%.
modifier.tprt.magic_arrow.flavor: Let the metal remember the path of magic
modifier.tprt.magic_arrow.description: Arrows turn into magic arrows on impact; each hit gains 1 Source Charge, and at 5 stacks magic arrow damage is +50%
modifier.tprt.source_alloy_charm.descrip: Greatly increases spell power at the cost of draining your mana; your spell projectiles ricochet 1 extra time
modifier.tprt.source_alloy_armor.flavor: The magic of nature flows toward you
modifier.tprt.source_alloy_armor.descrip: Increases spell resistance, max mana, and mana regeneration speed
modifier.tprt.mana_surge.description: Taking a hit grants Source Charge (up to 5 stacks), reducing damage taken by 5% per stack. At full stacks, a heavy hit consumes all stacks to reduce damage by 75%, spending 50 mana per point prevented; at least 25% of the damage remains.
modifier.tprt.arcane_echo.description: Casting records the last 3 spells and builds Source Charge; at 5 stacks all stacks are consumed and those 3 spells are re-cast in order (no mana, no cooldown, ignores invulnerability frames)
modifier.tprt.spell_greed.description: At full health, spell power increases by 10%. Each cast grants Greed for 8 seconds, adding 4% spell power and 4% cooldown reduction per stack, up to 5 stacks. Casting again refreshes the duration; all stacks expire together.
modifier.tprt.overlimit.flavor: Go beyond your limits to behold the stars.
modifier.tprt.overlimit.description: While worn as a charm, increases damage dealt by 15% and reduces protectable damage taken by 10%. Successful attacks or taking damage grant 1 stack (at most once per second), plus 1 extra stack at full health. At 5 stacks, enter Overlimit for 6 seconds: damage dealt increases to +30% and protectable damage reduction to 20%. No stacks can be gained during Overlimit.
modifier.tprt.ranged_greed.description: At full health, projectile damage increases by 20%. A successful hit grants 1 stack, or 2 if you were at full health when firing or the target was at full health before impact; stacks can be gained only once per shot. Each stack adds 5% projectile damage, up to 6 stacks, additive with the full-health bonus. After 4 seconds without a hit, lose 1 stack per second.
modifier.tprt.advanced_greed.description: At full health, attack damage increases by 20%. Each attack grants 1 stack, plus 1 extra stack if you or the target are at full health. Each stack increases attack damage by 5%, up to 6 stacks.
modifier.tprt.arrogant.description: Totals equipped armor levels, capped at 5. Each level reduces protectable damage by 8% at full health, 6% at half health or above, and 3% below half health. Stacks multiplicatively with other reductions.
modifier.tprt.shine_at_night.description: Increases maximum Polish by 25 points. Each melee hit restores 10 Polish. Above 100 Polish, consumes 25 Polish per second to deal an additional 50% damage.
modifier.tprt.dawn.description: Increases maximum Polish by 25 points. Each arrow hit restores 10 Polish. Above 100 Polish, consumes 25 Polish per hit to deal an additional 50% damage.
modifier.tprt.glow_armor.description: Increases maximum Polish by 50 points, continuously grants Glowing, and restores 5 Polish per second. While Glowing, reduces damage taken by 25%. Above 100 Polish while Glowing, instead consumes 20 Polish to reduce incoming damage by 75% and reflect damage based on your armor to its source.
modifier.tprt.the_shining_sun.descriptio: Increases damage dealt by 15%. At light levels above 10, grants an additional bonus that grows stronger with the light level.
modifier.tprt.burning_flames.description: Attacks reduce the target's armor and armor toughness and set it on fire.
modifier.tprt.wrath_of_flames.flavor: The wrath of the Nether Flame Lord
modifier.tprt.wrath_of_flames.descriptio: Increases damage dealt by 25%. Damage is greatly increased against targets with no armor.
modifier.tprt.cursed_spirit.flavor: Awaken the power of the death curse!
modifier.tprt.cursed_spirit.description: Attacking increases critical damage. At 3 stacks, attacks also damage nearby targets around you (with a cooldown).
modifier.tprt.soul_puncture.flavor: Tear the enemy's soul using the death curse
modifier.tprt.soul_puncture.description: Arrows ignore invulnerability frames, home in on targets, and have unlimited piercing.
modifier.tprt.soul_dodge.description: Grants a chance to completely negate incoming damage.
modifier.tprt.undead_revive.description: Upon death, immediately revives you with 20% health and 5 seconds of invulnerability. After revival, you are weakened for 6 minutes and cannot revive again while weakened.
message.tprt.undead_revive: You refused the invitation of death.
modifier.tprt.mechanical_star_att.flavor: A marvel of engineering, the embodiment of a war machine
modifier.tprt.mechanical_star_att.descri: Armor and toughness increase damage dealt. Hits lock onto targets (up to 3, 10s); attacking a locked target makes the other locked targets take the same hit, costing 10 charge each. While held, 4 redstone every 0.5s refills 10 charge (max 160)
modifier.tprt.mechanical_star_range.flav: A marvel of engineering, the embodiment of a war machine
modifier.tprt.mechanical_star_range.desc: Shots additionally fire homing wither missiles: count scales with Multishot, plus +1 per 20 armor (max +2), 2 charge each. Missile damage is computed from a fully drawn shot. Sneaking while shooting fires a Death Laser instead (8 charge, damage scales with Multishot). While held, 4 redstone every 0.5s refills 10 charge (max 160)
modifier.tprt.mechanical_star_arm.flavor: A marvel of engineering, the embodiment of a war machine
modifier.tprt.mechanical_star_arm.descri: Taking damage converts 20% of it into a shield (capped at 50% max health). While the shield holds you are immune to knockback. When it breaks, ARMOR OVERLOAD grants 3s of speed and knockback immunity (10s cooldown)
modifier.tprt.machine_iron_casting.flavo: The defensive properties of this high-density material are unparalleled, but it is also very heavy
modifier.tprt.cinder_slash.flavor: A devastating strike that spews lava
modifier.tprt.cinder_slash.description: Increases damage dealt by 40% and deals splash damage behind the target based on a portion of attack damage. Higher levels increase the splash range and multiplier.
modifier.tprt.monstrous.flavor: The menace of a monstrous beast
modifier.tprt.monstrous.description: While worn, falling below half health triggers an explosion that knocks back nearby entities, then grants increased defense, knockback resistance, and regeneration based on the total equipped modifier level.
modifier.tprt.soul_infection.flavor: Long-term immersion has filled it with soul power
modifier.tprt.soul_infection.description: Slightly increases all attributes of the tool
modifier.tprt.soul_surge.flavor: Long-term immersion has filled it with soul power
modifier.tprt.strong_but_pliable.flavor: Unique metal structure grants both strength and flexibility
modifier.tprt.strong_but_pliable.descrip: Base durability +500. Attack damage, armor value, and projectile power gradually increase as durability gets higher
modifier.tprt.ancient_sandstorm.descript: Attacking summons a large sandstorm tornado that revolves around you.
modifier.tprt.will_from_ancient.descript: Slightly increases tool attack power and projectile power. Attacks reduce part of the target's armor
modifier.tprt.amethyst_of_the_earth.desc: Increases knockback resistance. When attacked, fires damaging amethyst clusters around you. While also benefiting from Amethyst Protection, restore an extra 1% of maximum health every second and gain 50% natural healing.
modifier.tprt.tears_of_the_pearl_of_the_: Tears of the Pearl of the Sea

Block an attack within 0.2s of raising the shield: knock the attacker back about 2 blocks, grant them Slowness III and yourself Strength III for 10 seconds, and gain temporary health equal to 10% of your max health
modifier.tprt.tidal_surge.description: Hits apply Wetness (up to level V) and have a 50% chance to raise a wave. Against wet targets, the wave is guaranteed and twice as powerful.
modifier.tprt.storm_incarnation_att.flav: I'm the storm that is approaching.
modifier.tprt.storm_incarnation_att.desc: Increases attack damage by 35% (80% in water or rain). Attacking a target with Wetness V summons a thunderstorm at the impact point: 16 lightning storms in a ring and a lingering static field at the center (damage equal to 150% of your attack damage; 10-second cooldown).
modifier.tprt.storm_incarnation_arm.flav: I'm the storm that is approaching.
modifier.tprt.storm_incarnation_arm.desc: Reduces final damage taken by 2 (3 in water/rain); when accumulated damage reaches 50% of your max health, gain a shield that negates the next 5 attacks (5s trigger cooldown)
modifier.tprt.tide_walker.flavor: Walk the waves, ride the tide as wings
modifier.tprt.tide_walker.description: Immune to fall damage; walk on water; fly freely while in water; brief flight while it rains and you are not in water (max 10s, refilled on landing)
modifier.tprt.breath_of_the_abyss.flavor: To the deepest, to the darkest
modifier.tprt.breath_of_the_abyss.descri: Attacks inflict Abyssal Fear and deal additional void damage.
modifier.tprt.dimension_fragmentation.fl: The power to tear the dimension!
modifier.tprt.dimension_fragmentation.de: Attacks reduce the target's maximum health by 3% if it has Abyssal Fear. Otherwise, each attack reduces it by 1%, down to a minimum of 70% of its original maximum health.
modifier.tprt.void_scatter.description: On impact the arrow shatters into 17 void shards, each dealing 1.5 + 15% of the arrow's damage.
modifier.tprt.void_power.flavor: The technology of the End, boy!
modifier.tprt.void_power.description: Consumes one Void Stone every 0.5 seconds to replenish 10 Void Charge
modifier.tprt.ender_armor.flavor: Only the void can power this heavy armor
modifier.tprt.ender_armor.description: With Void Charge available, taking a hit consumes 1 charge to negate 30% of the damage. Above 50 charge, taking a hit consumes 20 additional charge to summon Void Runes in front of you. Without charge, the wearer suffers Slowness III.
modifier.tprt.void_armed.flavor: Powered by the void, your attacks become sharper
modifier.tprt.void_armed.description: With Void Charge available, improves tool stats and consumes 1 charge per attack to increase attack damage by 30%. Above 50 charge, instead consumes 10 charge to strike an extra time, but reduces attack damage to 75%. Without charge, tool stats are greatly reduced.
modifier.tprt.luck_strike.description: Attack damage has a chance to be multiplied. Higher Luck and modifier level increase the multiplier. Damage is reduced when not critical
modifier.tprt.metallization.description: Greatly improves arrow stats and lets arrows ignore gravity in flight, but reduces accuracy.
modifier.tprt.the_prestige_of_dragon.fla: The power of dragons lies within!
modifier.tprt.wrath_of_the_dragon.descri: Increases projectile power by 0.6 per level
modifier.tprt.brave_waves.description: The tool moves freely underwater without drag. Increases projectile damage against underwater targets by 50% per level. Fishing rods instead gain Luck of the Sea III.
modifier.tprt.tide_guardian.description: Grants Water Breathing. In water, rain, or thunderstorms, grants Strength equal to the total equipped modifier level (up to VIII).
modifier.tprt.ice_spell_power_improved.f: The chill of frost gives you deeper understanding of Ice spells
modifier.tprt.mana_improved.flavor: Contained magic makes your mana abundant
modifier.tprt.mana_improved.description: Increases max mana, mana regeneration speed, and spell resistance
modifier.tprt.spell_power_improved.flavo: This material is filled with magic
modifier.tprt.spell_power_improved.descr: Increases max mana and spell power
modifier.tprt.spell_power_improved_curio: This material is filled with magic
Increases max mana and spell power
modifier.tprt.ender_spell_power_improved: The echo of the End gives you deeper understanding of Ender spells
modifier.tprt.human_turpentine.descripti: Increases attack damage to 125%. Attacks deal additional dragon breath damage based on your spell power and Ender spell power.
modifier.tprt.marathon.description: Movement speed greatly increased while holding the weapon
modifier.tprt.bloodstain.description: Increases maximum mana and grants additional spell levels when casting Blood spells
modifier.tprt.light_the_fire.description: Melee attacks apply 1 stack of Immolation, causing an explosion at 3 stacks. Arrow hits trigger the explosion immediately.
modifier.tprt.flaming_torus.flavor: Burn all the evil things that dare to get close!
modifier.tprt.flaming_torus.description: When attacked, deals fire damage to the source, scaling with spell power.
modifier.tprt.fire_flow.description: Reduces damage taken by 2 points and increases damage dealt based on the wearer's Fire spell power.
modifier.tprt.flame_paradise.description: Increases Fire spell levels. Casting a Fire spell grants Strength and Absorption based on the spell's level.
modifier.tprt.nature_affinity.descriptio: Per level: Increases max health by 3
modifier.tprt.skeleton_affinity.flavor: Doo doo da doo doo da
modifier.tprt.skeleton_affinity.descript: Per level: Increases attack damage by 2
modifier.tprt.dwarf_power.flavor: Charge into the mines like a dwarf!
modifier.tprt.dwarf_power.description: Grants Haste effect equal to the trait level
modifier.tprt.sky_affinity.description: Grants one additional midair jump per 2 levels and reduces gravity affecting you
modifier.tprt.lightweight.description: Per level: Increases movement speed by 15% and jump height by 0.75 blocks
modifier.tprt.lightweight_spell.flavor: Casting is as simple as breathing now
modifier.tprt.lightweight_spell.descript: Increases spell cast time reduction by 20%
modifier.tprt.down_to_the_bone.flavor: Pain that goes deep into the marrow
modifier.tprt.burning_ash.description: Per level: Increases attack damage by 4
modifier.tprt.shielding.description: Per level: Increases armor value and armor toughness by 10%
modifier.tprt.ruthless_and_tyrannical.fl: What are you looking at?! Did I say you could look?!
modifier.tprt.ruthless_and_tyrannical.de: Per level: Increases attack damage by 20% and attack speed by 15%, but armor value reduced by 20%
modifier.tprt.ruthless_and_tyrannical_sp: What are you looking at?! Did I say you could look?!
Universal spell power increased by 25%, but armor value and spell resistance reduced by 25%
modifier.tprt.mana_regeneration.flavor: Lost mana returns in another form
modifier.tprt.mana_regeneration.descript: Per level: Increases mana regeneration by 24%
modifier.tprt.sunlit.flavor: The sun leaves evil nowhere to hide
modifier.tprt.sunlit.description: Per level: Increases critical damage by 20%
modifier.tprt.deep_darkness.description: Per level: Damage increased by 30% while sneaking
modifier.tprt.unreal_image.description: Grants continuous invisibility and periodically grants Resistance II
modifier.tprt.body_like_glass.descriptio: Damage dealt increased to 135%, but damage taken is doubled
modifier.tprt.fragile.flavor: You are more fragile than you think, but your attacks are also sharper
modifier.tprt.fragile.description: Max health reduced by 35%, but attack damage +25%
modifier.tprt.magician.description: Improves casting cooldown and spell cooldown
modifier.tprt.fountain_magic.description: Increases max mana and mana regeneration speed
modifier.tprt.elemental_mastery.descript: Spells realize their full potential in your hands. Increases Ice, Fire, Lightning, Nature, and Holy spell power by 10% per level.
modifier.tprt.endless_life.description: Grants high life regeneration and increases healing effects received
modifier.tprt.gas_poison.flavor: After being burned by this strange ancient crop, you had the idea to use it as a weapon
modifier.tprt.flourishing.description: Walking promotes growth of nearby crops. [Expanded] enhancement greatly increases the range
modifier.tprt.excellent_harvest.descript: Chance to gain extra mature crops and seeds when harvesting certain crops
modifier.tprt.lingering_infusion.flavor: The fragrance of tea fills the air, soothing the heart
modifier.tprt.lingering_infusion.descrip: When hit, gain a short Tea Aroma IV effect. If hit while having Tea Aroma, additionally gain a short Resistance III effect
modifier.tprt.breakphantom.description: Casting a spell while invisible removes your Invisibility and increases the spell's level by 2.
modifier.tprt.thorough.description: At light levels above 10, spells are cast 1 level higher, with an additional boost to Holy spells.
modifier.tprt.flame_rising.description: The power of this Flame Lord grants one upgrade slot and one defense slot
modifier.tprt.the_spirit_of_evil_curse.f: The power of curses reshapes your equipment
modifier.tprt.the_spirit_of_evil_curse.d: The power of this Cursed Undead grants one upgrade slot and one defense slot
modifier.tprt.mechanical_innovation.flav: Forge your equipment with this revolutionary material
modifier.tprt.mechanical_innovation.desc: The masterpiece of ancient engineering grants one upgrade slot and one defense slot
modifier.tprt.the_power_of_beast.flavor: The strange technology of ancient people enhances your equipment
modifier.tprt.the_power_of_beast.descrip: The legacy of the Nether ancients grants one upgrade slot and one defense slot
modifier.tprt.renovation_of_historic_sit: The remains of ancient ruins grant one upgrade slot and one defense slot
modifier.tprt.storm_potential.flavor: The essence of the storm enchants your equipment
modifier.tprt.storm_potential.descriptio: The untamable storm grants one upgrade slot and one defense slot
modifier.tprt.abyss_call.flavor: The power of the abyss enhances your equipment
modifier.tprt.abyss_call.description: The bottomless ocean abyss grants one upgrade slot and one defense slot
modifier.tprt.ender_echo.flavor: Echoes of the End reforge your equipment
modifier.tprt.ender_echo.description: Overlapping echoes of the End grant one upgrade slot and one defense slot
modifier.tprt.amethyst_protection.flavor: Through blessing, your equipment gains a special power
modifier.tprt.amethyst_protection.descri: While held or worn, grants 2 seconds of Blessing of Amethyst every second. This tool deals 25% more damage to undead and aquatic mobs.
modifier.tprt.thunder.description: Right-click with the tool to fire a Lightning Spear
modifier.tprt.soul_render.description: Hold right-click to dash rapidly. While sneaking, instead summons Phantom Halberds in a ring around you.
modifier.tprt.meat_shredder.description: Right-click with the tool to attack entities in front of you, ignoring invulnerability frames.
modifier.tprt.infernal_forge.description: Right click at a block to cause AOE damage. [Expanded] enhancement increases the range
modifier.tprt.the_incinerator.descriptio: Hold right-click for 1 second to charge, then release to summon a Flame Strike in the direction you are facing. Warning: mob drops may be destroyed by the Flame Strike's explosion.
modifier.tprt.bulwark_of_the_flame.descr: While sneaking and holding this shield, right-click to charge forward and damage entities in your path. Targets knocked into a wall take extra damage and are briefly stunned.
modifier.tprt.cursed_spirit_arrow.flavor: Infuse arrows with the power of curses
modifier.tprt.cursed_spirit_arrow.descri: Fired arrows gain +1 piercing and become Phantom Arrows
modifier.tprt.cursed_sandstorm.flavor: Tear enemies apart with a cursed sandstorm!
modifier.tprt.cursed_sandstorm.descripti: Replaces fired arrows with a three-shot spread of cursed sandstorms, at no extra ammunition or durability cost.
modifier.tprt.ancient_spear.description: Left-click to fire a small sandstorm
modifier.tprt.gauntlet_of_guard.descript: Right-click to pull entities closer and deal dragon breath damage to nearby entities
modifier.tprt.philosophers_stone.flavor: The crystallization of alchemy reconstructs your equipment
modifier.tprt.philosophers_stone.descrip: The pinnacle work of alchemy grants one upgrade slot, one defense slot, and one ability slot
“Then I ask you, why is your head pointy?”
The dragons roaming the world grant one upgrade slot and one defense slot. Tool attack power +9%
modifier.tprt.ancient_relics.description: Slumbering ancient crops grant two upgrade slots and one ability slot
modifier.tprt.taboo_knowledge.descriptio: Mysterious ancient knowledge grants one upgrade slot
modifier.tprt.solid_armor.flavor: Forge your armor, making it more solid
modifier.tprt.solid_armor.description: Gain one defense slot at the cost of one upgrade slot
modifier.tprt.armor_fragmentation.flavor: Shatter your armor, making it more malleable
modifier.tprt.armor_fragmentation.descri: Gain one upgrade slot at the cost of one defense slot
modifier.tprt.enchantment.flavor: Enchant your item, making its abilities stronger
modifier.tprt.enchantment.description: Gain one ability slot at the cost of two upgrade slots
modifier.tprt.advanced_cheer_up.flavor: Life energy surges within the body
modifier.tprt.advanced_cheer_up.descript: Per level: Increases max health by 5%
modifier.tprt.advanced_cheer_up.requirem: Requires the Heart of Life modifier
modifier.tprt.spell_resist.flavor: “Your spells aren't working. What could be wrong?”

modifier.tprt.all_permitted.description: Sneak-right-click to switch forms instantly. Running out returns you to [Xu] and inflicts Sin (land 5 Xu hits to atone).

modifier.tprt.what_do_you_do_at_the_end_: What Do You Do at the End of the World? Are You Busy? Will You Save Us?
Even as the sun sets and no future is in sight, please never forget the brilliance of this very moment.

A single piece (Lv.1) grants full baseline strength, and the total equipped modifier level L (normally 1-8) pushes its limits even further. [1st Question] 15% base DR (+3% per extra level) and up to +25% missing-HP DR (+4% per extra level, up to 89% at Lv.8); caps single-hit final damage at 50% max HP (-4% per extra level, down to 22% at Lv.8). [2nd Question] At 50% HP (+3% per extra level), plant a Memory Anchor and defer 50% (+4% per extra level, 78% at Lv.8) of incoming damage into a delayed pool draining at 20%/s (-1.5%/s per extra level). [3rd Question] Lethal damage locks HP at 1 and triggers 6s (+0.5s per extra level) Crimson Berserk (+35% all damage & universal lifesteal, +5% per extra level; overhealing offsets the pool); when Berserk ends, survive in place if HP > pool (30s CD, -2s/lvl; Lv.2+ cleanses debuffs & grants 20%+4%xL max HP shield) or trigger Time Rewind back to the Anchor (60s CD, -4s/lvl; Lv.4+ unleashes a 6-block pure true damage Causality Burst for 80%+10%xL cleared pool at both the rewind origin and destination).

modifier.tprt.seniorious.flavor: The strongest holy sword, assembled from forty-one talismans, granting true rest to the undying.
modifier.tprt.seniorious.description: Heartfire caps at 256. Sneak-right-click to switch stances at any time (1-second cooldown). [Azure] Hits reduce enemy healing by 80%, steal 4% armor per stack, and grant you 4% attack damage per stack (up to 5). True-damage conversion is calculated from the monster's armor and attack damage. Hits grant 10 Heartfire and kills grant 20; killing a target whose armor was stolen doubles Heartfire. Reaching 256 automatically enters [Crimson]. [Crimson] Ignores invulnerability frames and prevents all healing. Combos stack up to 10 times (+18% true damage and +3% attack speed per stack). Each strike spends Heartfire in steps of 1/2/4/8/16 to add pure true damage; kills reset the cost tier. The 10th combo hit opens [Gate of Fairyland], spending all remaining Heartfire to deal true damage within 6 blocks, scaling with the amount spent. Then returns to [Azure] to rest for 3 seconds (land 3 hits to end the rest early).

modifier.tprt.happiest_girl_in_the_world: Right Now, No Matter What Anyone Says, I Am Definitely the Happiest Girl in the World

[Right Now] Beneficial potion effects last twice as long; at half health or above, their level also increases by 1 (up to V). Healing received increases by 30%, and all overhealing becomes a Happiness Shield (golden hearts, capped at 100% maximum health). Eating immediately grants a shield equal to (food restored × 3%) of maximum health. At 16 or more hunger, naturally nurtures 2% per second, up to 40%. [No Matter What Anyone Says] While you have a Happiness Shield or Happiness Finale is active, you are immune to knockback and all negative effects, and take 40% less armor-bypassing damage. [The Happiest Girl in the World] When a shield that reached at least 20% of maximum health shatters in combat (25-second cooldown), releases an 8-block Starfire Shockwave and activates [Happiness Finale] for 8 seconds: +25% attack damage, +25% armor, and +25% attack speed. Each attack also deals pure true damage equal to 35% of attack damage + 50% of peak shield, and restores 25% health.

modifier.tprt.elegy_of_world_end.flavor: In this world under the setting sun, atop the Forest in the Sky. When this war finally ends, those who never return and those who wait in vain...
modifier.tprt.elegy_of_world_end.descrip: [Elegy Lingering Note] Any spell damage you deal leaves an Elegy Note on the target for 5 seconds. While it lasts, 40% of all damage you deal to that target (including spells, melee, ranged, and summons) is stored in the note. Every second, it deals 30% of the stored damage as pure true damage, ignoring invulnerability frames and magic resistance. After 5 seconds, or when the target's remaining health is no greater than the stored damage, it detonates for the full stored amount, restoring health equal to 20% and mana equal to 50% of the detonation damage.

modifier.tprt.before_i_vanish: Before I Vanish, I Wish to Remain in Someone's Heart
modifier.tprt.before_i_vanish.flavor: If I cannot escape death, then at least before I vanish, I wish to remain in someone's heart.
modifier.tprt.before_i_vanish.descriptio: [Entrusted Blade: Autonomous Guardian] While this weapon is in your hotbar or offhand and not held in your main hand (e.g., while casting with a spellbook, shooting a bow, or eating), it manifests as an autonomous floating sword at your side: every 0.2s it automatically slashes down incoming hostile projectiles within 4 blocks, and every 1s it automatically lunges out to slash enemies within 5 blocks using the weapon's full Tinkers attack and modifiers. When durability would drop to zero, it refuses to break, locking at 1 durability and entering a 15s [Before Vanishing] state (45s CD): durability loss is negated, autonomous slash interval shortens to 0.5s, and killing any enemy or landing 6 hits during those 15s reforges the blade, restoring 35% of max durability.

modifier.tprt.even_as_the_sun_sets.flavo: Please never forget the brilliance of this very moment.
modifier.tprt.even_as_the_sun_sets.descr: [Time-Frozen Watch] Releasing the bow while sneaking suspends arrows at your side as [Waiting Arrows] instead of firing them (up to 8 for 15 seconds). They automatically fire head-on at rushing enemies within 4 blocks, driving them back. [Setting Sun Blade] When an arrow fired without sneaking hits a target: (1) all Waiting Arrows simultaneously lock onto that target across space, each independently dealing 100% arrow damage and ignoring invulnerability frames; (2) a Tinkers' melee weapon from your hotbar or offhand manifests above the target and delivers a full melee slash with all of its stats and modifiers, plus 1 extra slash per 3 Waiting Arrows released, up to 3 slashes; (3) releasing the bow while airborne with enemies approaching within 6 blocks causes a light backward-upward blink to create distance. [Fairy's Return] Arrows gain +3 piercing and plant [Waymarks of No Return] behind enemies (up to 8 for 12 seconds). Reaching 6 Waymarks automatically triggers their return, or left-click while holding the bow to recall them manually. They reverse course, piercing all enemies along the return path from behind for 85% damage and pulling them toward the center of the threads. Each returning Waymark restores 2 durability to the bow, and half reform as Waiting Arrows at your side.
